set.body:
Source of truth: PRD.html (founding product requirements, 2026-07-22).

Objective:
Deliver a low-level Scala 3 library for truthful Slurm interaction locally on HPC systems and remotely through the normal OpenSSH path. The product must expose typed scheduler evidence, explicit effects, durable optional control, resumable logs, opaque scripts, and registered typed Scala computations without conflating command invocation, scheduler acceptance, workload completion, and valid results.

Required outcomes:
- One Scheduler[F] contract with local CLI and SSH-agent parity.
- Standard Slurm commands are the correctness-defining baseline; slurmrestd remains optional after CLI parity; native libslurm is not required.
- Submission, observation, accounting, cancellation, freshness, and failure planes are explicit ADTs.
- Managed submissions persist intent before execution can become unobservable and represent AcceptanceUnknown without blind retry.
- stdout and stderr are bounded, byte-cursor resumable evidence streams.
- Opaque scripts support exit-only and declared-output contracts.
- A language-neutral result envelope supports registered Scala operations with typed bounded return values; arbitrary closures and IO[A] are never serialized.
- Site capabilities, resource resolution, unknown Slurm values, raw evidence, security boundaries, and controller load are explicit.
- Deterministic fault injection, interpreter conformance laws, disposable-cluster coverage, and real-site evidence gate v1.

Non-goals:
Workflow/DAG orchestration, exactly-once scheduler execution, workload sandboxing, automatic proof of retry safety, mandatory slurmrestd, or a general remote filesystem browser.

Completion rule:
Keep this epic open until every child slice is closed with implementation and test evidence and the PRD v1 acceptance criteria are audited against live code. Tracker closure alone is not proof.
set.title: EPIC: Deliver scala-slurm v1
